Paragraph: "And these peacocks that dance here and there are shining forth with crystal like windows on their plumage, when up-shoved by the wind...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Peacocks displaying and dancing with their feathers lifted by the wind.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama observes the beautiful, crystal-like patterns on the peacock feathers.
Outcome/Resolution: He captures a striking visual detail of forest life.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Gavaaksha (Window-like eyes of beauty in creation)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The peacock's eyes (plumage) catching the wind symbolize windows of divine vision opening up throughout creation.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Detailed observation of natural elegance acts as a brief anchor, regulating visual and cognitive attention.
